name: Yashiro Ito
source:
The acting owner of Aporia. She is thoughtful, sincere, but also timid. Because she is the type whose expressions turns stiff when get nervous, she's tend to be misunderstood as a cold person.

She tends to have negative thoughts; she would humblling herself into saying "there's plenty of people who can take her place." 

Only her given name is changeable.
